cohort: The study included 739 children aged 7-12 years (544 preterm-born at <=34 weeks of gestation and 195 term-born) from the Respiratory Health Outcomes in Neonates (RHiNO) study.
finding: Gestation and intra-uterine growth restriction (IUGR) are significantly associated with prematurity-associated lung disease (PLD) in childhood, but bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) is not.
gest_age: <=34 weeks of gestation (for preterm) and term-born
